open_ended_contract.objective: Determine whether a SQLite online backup can remain a transactionally coherent snapshot when writes occur concurrently during the backup, and derive a minimal safe operating method.

goal_text: Determine whether a SQLite online backup can remain a transactionally coherent snapshot when writes occur concurrently during the backup, and derive a minimal safe operating method. Do not assume the answer, authority, source, tool, experiment, or procedure in advance. Autonomously decompose the problem; discover and evaluate authoritative primary evidence; select and use appropriate tools; define a precise consistency criterion; design and perform a reproducible real experiment; quantify or machine-check the consequential observations; revise the plan if evidence contradicts assumptions; independently cross-check the consequential conclusion; and return a decision-quality result with provenance, limitations, boundary conditions, and the minimal safe operating method.

must_include: producer-selected authoritative primary evidence with provenance
reproducible real experiment and observed results
quantitative or machine-checkable evidence for backup usability and consistency
independent cross-check of the consequential conclusion

independent_oracle.method: Only after producer terminal success, independently inspect the producer's cited primary evidence and rerun a separately implemented concurrent-write/online-backup consistency experiment without importing producer modules. Verify the backup opens, integrity checks pass, committed transaction groups are internally coherent under the independently defined criterion, and the producer's conclusion does not exceed the observed evidence.
